summary: User-facing template: service disruption in progress
content: We are aware that some users are experiencing issues with {service} since ~{time}. Our team is investigating. Next update by {next_update}. We apologize for the inconvenience.
The issue affecting {service} has been resolved as of {time}. If you continue to experience problems, please raise a new ticket. Thank you for your patience.
{ticket_count} correlated tickets in {window} min, suspected cause: {suspected_cause}. Severity: {severity}. Status: being tracked. ETA next update: {next_update}.
Incident {incident_id} ({severity}) affecting {service} has been resolved. Root cause: {root_cause}. Total duration: {duration}. Post-mortem to follow.

summary: User-facing template: cause identified, fix in progress
content: Update on the {service} issue: we have identified the cause and our engineers are working on a fix. Expected next update: {next_update}. There is no need to raise additional tickets; existing tickets will be updated when the service is restored.

{service} is currently unavailable for all users since ~{time}. This is being handled as a {severity} incident with the highest priority. Please do not restart your equipment and do not raise duplicate tickets. Next update: {next_update}.

summary: User-facing template: cloud storage provider disruption
content: Our cloud storage provider is reporting a disruption affecting {service} since ~{time}. Files already on your computer remain available: please keep working locally and your changes will sync automatically when the service is restored. Next update: {next_update}.

Network connectivity at your site has been disrupted since ~{time}. IT is working on the problem. If you must stay connected, you may use your mobile phone as a hotspot where company policy allows. Next update: {next_update}.
Email delivery is currently delayed. Messages are not lost and will be delivered once the backlog clears. For time-critical communication please use Teams or the phone. Next update: {next_update}.
Printing is currently unavailable since ~{time}. Please use digital documents and e-signature where possible; urgent print jobs can be sent to the Service Desk. Next update: {next_update}.
Update on incident {incident_id} ({severity}, {service}): {ticket_count} related tickets so far. Suspected cause: {suspected_cause}. Mitigation is in progress. Next update: {next_update}.

summary: Management-facing template: severe incident executive notification
content: {severity} declared for {service} at {time}. Organisation-wide business impact. {ticket_count} correlated tickets in {window} min. Suspected cause: {suspected_cause}. Incident bridge is open. Next update: {next_update}.

summary: Management-facing template: alert reviewed, not a major incident
content: {ticket_count} tickets about {service} in {window} min were assessed as {suspected_cause} and do not meet major-incident criteria ({severity}). They are handled through the standard service desk process. No executive action required.

Vendor-side incident impacting {service}: the root cause is at the third-party provider. Our team is monitoring the provider status and managing user communication. Severity: {severity}. Next update: {next_update}.
